title: The WideMess test cartridge (a conformance cartridge for spec 1.0)
description: One WideMess cartridge whose menu runs the console's tests live and judges itself (docs/projects/widemess-spec.md): eight layers of 256 colours, the 256-sprite table and its line limits, windows and colour math at 400, the SNES modes drawn 400 wide, the 32 voices with 16-bit PCM and BRR, fast CPU and fast DMA against the spec's cycle model, the memories (1 MB work RAM, 512 KB video RAM, 1 MB sound RAM), the identity registers. Results in a table in work RAM ($7E:1000) and on screen; SELECT held at power-on runs every self-check. 65816 and SPC700 in WLA-DX, data from gen_testcart.py (with milestone 2's model of the spec drawing each picture page's reference). WideMess/testcart/README.md.

toolchain: WLA-DX 10.7 (wla-65816, wla-spc700, wlalink) of PVSnesLib 4.6.0, the copy in the Super VRUN workspace (snes-stub/toolchain/pvsneslib/devkitsnes/bin): read, never changed

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1: gen_testcart.py (the data, the reference pictures), wla-spc700 and wla-65816, wlalink, Workshop --wms-pack --map 2. Into the project's build folder (WideMess\testroms\bin holds the copy the apps and --wms-test use).

run.note: The d-pad and A choose a test, B or START go back to the menu; SELECT held at power-on runs every self-check.

scenarios.why: SELECT held at power-on: every self-check runs unattended and the summary shows (the results table at $7E:1000 says state 3; Workshop --wms-testcart reads it)

compare.why: the run-all's summary is not the menu
